title: Goblin Mechanic's Digital Hex
summary: In a future city, a chubby goblin mechanic with distinctive braids fumbled with a charm, hoping to magnify his luck amidst glowing architecture and bustling skyways. Unbeknownst to him, a subtle hex caused a digital divorce from his network, as a shadowy ghoul watched. Under a collapsing galactic bunker, he worked with haste, avoiding falling debris, while an idiot mercenary passed by. The goblin's knuckles whitened as he latched his compass to a console, witnessing an ultimatum for the planet's closure amidst a midnight festival of emergency lights and digital ghosts. From an overhead view, the goblin, now with a small bunny and donkey, backtracked through a smog-choked global shop, carrying a foolish hope as turbojet engines rumbled in the distance.
protagonist: a chubby goblin with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
